problem_statement: The Zephyr USB host stack has no Video Class (UVC) class driver. A UVC host instance must be instantiated at boot (CONFIG_USBH_VIDEO_CLASS selects a default instance count of 1, creating a device named "usbh_uvc_0") so that host-side video class support can be probed by name via device_get_binding. Currently no such host UVC device is created, so a binding by that name returns NULL.
twister_command: scripts/twister -p native_sim/native/64 -T tests/subsys/usb/uvc -s tests/subsys/usb/uvc/usb.uvc -s usb.uvc -O twister-out --no-clean -W

verification.reason: The problem statement clearly describes the core requirement: CONFIG_USBH_VIDEO_CLASS must select a default instance count of 1, creating a device named 'usbh_uvc_0' at boot, so that device_get_binding("usbh_uvc_0") returns non-NULL. The hidden test's only assertion depending on the fix is exactly this binding check. All other symbols used by the test (USBH_CONTROLLER_DEFINE, usbh_context, usbh_init/enable/disable/shutdown, uvc_set_video_dev, uvc_add_format, sample_usbd_setup_device, usbd_init/enable, uhc_bus_reset/resume/sof_enable, etc.) are existing APIs in the repository that the agent can discover. The 'usbh_context' flagged by the program is an existing struct already defined in zephyr/usb/usbh.h, so it is not a missing name.
verification.note: manual check: usbh_context existed before the PR (name check false alarm)
